```{r}
#| results: asis
source("lidarbench_report.R")
lb_banner()
```

Facts frozen in the campaign identity when it was created (operating system,
hardware, tools, datasets) plus recorded-but-not-compared provenance.

## Operating system and hardware

```{r}
#| results: asis
environment <- lb_table("environment")
lb_kable(environment)
```

## Tools

```{r}
#| results: asis
lb_kable(lb_table("tools"))
details <- lb_table("tool_details")
if (!is.null(details) && nrow(details)) {
  cat("### Tool details\n\n")
  lb_kable(details[details$kind == "detail", c("tool", "key", "value"), drop = FALSE])
  cat("Executable paths and SHA-256 digests: [tool_details.csv](tables/tool_details.csv)\n\n")
}
```
